description: Searches the World Bank Listing of Ineligible Firms and Individuals for debarred and ineligible firms and individuals. Each hit: list, name, country, grounds, from/to dates, source URL. If a list is unreachable, returns listsUnavailable and 503 when none are checked. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
